questions.question: What famous prophecy of a child appears in Isaiah 9?
options: 'A new king shall arise to rule the land of Egypt'
'A mighty king of Babylon shall be brought low'
'For to us a child is born, to us a son is given'
'Behold, a judge shall come to deliver his people'
questions.answer: 'For to us a child is born, to us a son is given'

questions.question: By which names is this child called in Isaiah 9?
options: Bright Morning Star, Lion of Judah, Root of David, and Branch of Life
King of all Kings, Lord of all Lords, Ruler of All, and Judge of Earth
Holy One of Israel, great Redeemer, Rock of Ages, and Shield of Faith
Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace
questions.answer: Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace

questions.question: Isaiah 9 says the people who walked in darkness have seen a great light.
For to us a child is born, to us a _____ is given.
And his name shall be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of _____.
